title: Autumn Performance Baseline
summary: Stable baseline release featuring standard canvas rendering, single-threaded export, and legacy session-based authentication.
changes: Optimized database index for project loading
Standard canvas DOM renderer with 60fps cap
Basic PDF and PNG export utilities
known_risks: Canvas performance degrades slightly on boards with >500 elements.

title: Next-Gen WebWorker Async Canvas Engine
summary: Major architectural overhaul offloading canvas rendering calculations to background WebWorkers for infinite scaling.
changes: Migrated canvas transformation calculations to DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope
Added multi-user cursor broadcasting over WebSockets
known_risks: High memory consumption on prolonged editing sessions if WebGL buffer is not deallocated.

title: Canvas Memory Hotfix & Auth Refresh Interval Tuning
summary: Emergency hotfix to patch client RAM leaks in WebWorker, along with enterprise SSO token refresh interval adjustments.
changes: Enforced aggressive canvas node garbage collection on zoom/pan
Shortened enterprise Okta/SAML OAuth token refresh check from 4h to 45m
Added memory warning toast when tab exceeds 1.5GB RAM
known_risks: Short token check introduces race condition when multiple tabs renew token concurrently without mutex lock.

title: OAuth Mutex Fix & Canvas WebGL Stabilization
summary: Comprehensive stability update resolving OAuth token refresh race conditions and WebGL context loss.
changes: Implemented distributed WebLock/mutex for single-tab OAuth renewal
Fixed GPU buffer deallocation in Canvas worker upon node deletion
Added automatic offline draft persistence if connection drops
known_risks: Minimal. Verified in staging across Chrome 124, Safari 18, and Firefox ESR.
